title: Log Block Tool
description: LogBlockTool logs block breaks, placements, container transactions, and player interactions on a Minecraft server. It’s lightweight, fast, and designed for Paper/Spigot with SQLite or MySQL support.
body:
# LogBlockTool 🪵✨ [![Paper 1.21+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Paper-1.21+-blue.svg)](https://papermc.io/) [![Paper 1.20+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Paper-1.20+-blue.svg)](https://papermc.io/)
--- ## ✅ Features - Block break and place logging - Container transactions (insert/remove with item + amount) - Interaction logging for doors, trapdoors, fence gates, buttons, levers, and pressure plates - Container opening logs - Quick history lookup with the Log Block Stick - Colored, clean chat formatting with timestamps - Page navigation with interactive arrows (10 logs per page) - SQLite and MySQL support - Async database writes for smooth performance ---
![1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cd5f3dfb800c8a162b15c7313c78e657b92397f1.png) ![1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/32ba78dc55cfcec05c779899821b852a14cccf2a.png)
--- ## 🧭 How to Use 1. Run `/lb` to get the Log Block Stick. 2. Right-click any block with the stick to view its history. 3. Customize settings in `config.yml`. --- ## 💬 Commands - `/lb` — gives the Log Block Stick --- ## 🔐 Permissions - `logblocktool.use` — use the stick (default: everyone) - `logblocktool.admin` — receive update notifications (default: op) --- ## ⚙️ Configuration - Database type (SQLite or MySQL) - Logging categories (block break/place, container actions, interactions) - Max logs per block and cleanup settings - Permission mode (everyone, op, permission) - Custom date/time formats and time zone - Update checker toggle --- ## 💾 Database Support - SQLite (default, file-based) - MySQL (remote or local) --- ## ✅ Compatibility - Minecraft 1.21.x (primary target) - Compatible with 1.20.x+ - Paper and Spigot supported - Folia best-effort support --- ## 🚀 Performance Notes - Async database writes - Minimal event overhead - Configurable logging categories and log limits --- ## Support: - on [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/sD4HvQh8P4) --- ## 🌟 License The source code is not publicly available, but if you want to edit something in the plugin for your own needs, update the plugin to a new version or anything else, contact me on discord server and we will definitely come to an agreement ---
**Made with ❤️ for the Minecraft community**
